LESSON: SELECTED SURAH • AL- HUMAZA • AL-ASR • AT- TAKATHUR • AL-QARIAH

Grade: Grade 6
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Qur’an
Topic 1.1: Selected Surah • Al- Humaza • Al-Asr • At- Takathur • Al-Qariah
Suggested lessons in curriculum: 12

SECTION 1: INTRODUCTION

This lesson covers Selected Surah • Al- Humaza • Al-Asr • At- Takathur • Al-Qariah, part of Qur’an in Grade 6 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION.

Key inquiry question: What are the effects of backbiting? 2. How can Muslims use time well? 3. How can Muslims prepare for the Day of Judgement?

You will study the official KICD learning outcomes, classroom activities, values, and competencies for this topic. Use Kenyan examples from your county, school, and community throughout.

SECTION 2: LEARNING OUTCOMES

By the end of this topic, you should be able to:

Refer to the KICD curriculum reference at the end of this lesson for the full list of outcomes.

SECTION 3: KEY CONCEPTS AND EXPLANATION

A. Suggested learning experiences (from KICD)

1. listen to verses of the selected surah from a teacher/resource person/digital device and repeat afterwards,

2. read and recite the selected surah with the aid of digital devices/mus’haf/chart,

3. discuss the basic meaning of the selected surah and make notes,

4. match and sort the verses of the selected surah with their corresponding meaning using flash cards,

5. brainstorm on the lessons learnt from the selected surah and present in class,

6. dramatise the teachings of the selected surah. 1.

SECTION 4: LEARNING ACTIVITIES

A. At school

1. listen to verses of the selected surah from a teacher/resource person/digital device and repeat afterwards,
2. read and recite the selected surah with the aid of digital devices/mus’haf/chart,
3. discuss the basic meaning of the selected surah and make notes,
4. match and sort the verses of the selected surah with their corresponding meaning using flash cards,
5. brainstorm on the lessons learnt from the selected surah and present in class,
6. dramatise the teachings of the selected surah. 1.

B. At home with your parent or guardian

1. Read this lesson on Selected Surah • Al- Humaza • Al-Asr • At- Takathur • Al-Qariah together.
2. Discuss the key inquiry question and give examples from your area.
3. Write five sentences summarising what you learned.
4. Prepare for the revision quiz at the end of this topic.

SECTION 5: CORE COMPETENCIES, VALUES, AND PCIs

Core Competencies to be developed:
• Citizenship: Information and communication skills attained as learners discuss the basic meaning of the selected surah and

make notes.

• Digital Literacy: interacting with digital devices enhanced when reading/memorising the selected surah.

• Communication and Collaboration: listening, speaking, writing and teamwork skills attained through group discussions

and brainstorming on the lessons learnt from the selected surah.

Values:
Unity: cooperation is attained when discussing the basic meaning of the selected surah and brainstorm on the lessons learnt.

Link to other Learning Areas: English- Learners acquire new vocabularies as they learn the meaning of the surah.
